title: Jamesray Ajido places 5th in men's 100 fly in Youth Olympic Games

blocks.text: DAKAR—Jamesray Mishael Ajido had the skills but lacked the length and finished fifth in the men’s 100-meter butterfly in the 4th Youth Olympic Games on Sunday. Pitted against taller opponents, Ajido clocked 55.16 seconds to better his time in the morning qualifiers where he placed seventh, but it wasn’t enough for the bemedalled Asian juniors swimmer to break the podium here. Egypt’s Ali Sain looked even more formidable in the final, erasing his heat’s best time with a 53.96 at the Complexe Tour de l’Ceuf pool.
